summary: 3D Black Sea fishing and boat-management game, redesigned with a dark-steel instrument UI, sonar-green accents and a misty harbour, built by Claude Sonnet 5.5 · Karadeniz'de 3D balıkçılık ve tekne yönetimi oyunu, koyu çelik gösterge arayüzü, sonar yeşili ve sisli limanla yeniden tasarlandı, Claude Sonnet 5.5 yaptı
key_features: A boat that handles like a boat; sonar schools that swim as boids; set the purse-seine net around them and haul
Redesign: a dark-steel instrument UI with sonar-green accents, a sonar ping ring and rain droplets on the screen in storms
Redesign: a slate-tinted capped mist, harbour houses with windows and chimneys, sodium lamps, an A-frame and crew hats
A 30-day season: sell fresh at the market, refuel, add ice, pay the boat loan and buy upgrades
Measured after the redesign: 60 fps; the 30-day ?auto season finishes with 0 JS errors

social.headline: Net the schools, beat the storm and pay off the boat in 30 days · Sürüleri ağla, fırtınayı atlat, tekne kredisini 30 günde öde
